what_i_see: A row of three galaxies spanning 9 arcsec: an orange edge-on disc to the east, a ragged blue clumpy galaxy in the middle at the centre, and a small spiral to the west. The middle one seems to touch the spiral.
most_likely: A clumpy blue irregular galaxy interacting with, or merely projected next to, the neighbouring spiral.
decisive_test: Redshifts of the three galaxies to see whether they are a physical group.
catalogue_notes: Legacy photo-z: 0.59±0.13 at 3.2 arcsec, 0.85±0.38 at 4.3 (poor quality). SIMBAD: nothing within 60; NED nearest WISEA source 15.9. Gaia none within 16. Four lens lists: no match within 60.
